faqs.q: State the difference between generative AI, machine learning, and traditional AI.
a: Traditional AI follows a set of pre-defined rules to perform tasks. Machine learning, on the other hand, adapts and learns patterns from data to make future predictions and informed decisions. Generative AI goes a step further; it learns from the vast datasets and generates new content in the form of text, images, code, videos, etc. that resemble human creativity.

Generative AI utilizes Large Language Models (LLMs) that are trained on massive datasets to interpret patterns, relationships, and context. Based on this learning, the model then generates new content with the given input.
